messages:
Morgan: Quick async qtr check — brief please: what shipped, what slipped, owners, deps, next steps. Use tiny bullets. I’ll consolidate by EOD Fri. Template: SHIPPED / SLIPPED / BLOCKER / NEXT. Thanks!

Javi: SHIPPED: autoscale v2 core (PR #432 merged -> staging). Perf: ~22% p50 improvement. Owner @javi. NEXT: prod canary this Fri. Need infra signoff. :rocket:

Priya: SLIPPED: dedicated-capacity autoscaler policy rollout (depends on partner image update). Owner @priya. ETA +2w unless partner signs off today. BLOCKER: partner image & infra image push. Workaround: static pool fallback. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234

Lenora: INF ticket opened INF-987 for quota/image push. I can escalate with partner ops. We’ll need SRE coverage for canary — who’s available Fri evening? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Chris: I can support Friday canary window. FYI runtime change to kv-cache landed but requires migration script run before canary. Quick command: `./scripts/migrate_kv_cache.sh --dry-run` Owner @chris.

Eva: Design shipped updated prompt guidelines + sample configs for embeddings. Doc link shared in #docs. No blockers from design side. :white_check_mark:

Javi: SLIPPED: reranking evals flagged regressions in low-temp cases — will roll back model variant for affected routes. Owner @javi. NEXT: run additional evals, reopen PRs #438 & #440. Requesting routing freeze during rollback window.

Priya: Ack — I’ll freeze routing policy for targeted customers and add feature-flag gate for re-enable. Suggest window + postmortem for rollout.

Morgan: Two asks: 1) owners confirm prod ETA for autoscale canary by Fri 18:00 PT; 2) Priya/Lenora confirm who owns rollback + oncall. I’ll compile a short exec summary after replies.

Lenora: I can own SRE oncall for the canary window (Fri 17:00–21:00 PT).

Javi: Canary ETA: Friday 19:00 PT (aiming for 18:30 smoke, 19:00 ramp) — assuming no image hold. I’ll trigger canary and monitor.

Priya: I’ll own rollback policy + feature-flag gating. Will be on standby Fri 17:30–20:30 PT.

Morgan: Great — I’ll draft the consolidated update: autoscale v2 canary Fri 19:00 PT, SRE oncall Lenora, rollback owner Priya, runtime migration script owned by Chris. Any objections?

Javi: No objections. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging -> prod autoscale-v2 canary queued for 2025-07-11T18:30:00Z by @javi

Morgan: Thanks everyone — I’ll post the exec snippet and close this thread unless more notes come in.
